title: Daily RSI14 midline momentum-state long/cash timing
thesis: When the balance of the prior fourteen complete daily BTC gains and losses keeps RSI above its neutral midline, positive short-horizon momentum may persist strongly enough that a causal next-open long/cash policy preserves material upside while avoiding enough adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, sum positive and absolute negative close changes over the latest fourteen changes and compute RSI as 100 times gains divided by gains plus losses. The strategy is fully long BTC when the completed-day RSI is strictly above a frozen threshold and otherwise holds zero-yield cash, with state changes executed at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: RSI14 measures the breadth and magnitude balance of recent gains versus losses rather than one endpoint return, a price breakout, moving-average state or volume flow. The mechanism is useful only if the fixed 50 midline retains material upside after costs while reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with broad annual and threshold-neighbor support.
